tools_helpful.evidence: Agent iterated build->fix->build (11 dotnet build invocations) and reached BUILD SUCCEEDED; native dotnet build surfaced CS0118/CS0576/CS0103/CS0234 clearly (session-log turns 31-50).

tool_limitations.limitation: Only rewrites Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml. It does NOT rewrite the other Windows.UI.* namespaces that also moved (Windows.UI.Colors/ColorHelper -> Microsoft.UI.*), so those surface as build errors the agent must hand-fix.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Extend step 3 to also rewrite the unambiguous tokens Windows.UI.Colors->Microsoft.UI.Colors and Windows.UI.ColorHelper->Microsoft.UI.ColorHelper (leaving the Windows.UI.Color struct untouched).

failed_apis.why_tried: Direct port of the UWP sample code that does `using Windows.Devices.Sensors;` then `Accelerometer.GetDefault()`.
failed_apis.root_cause: The WinUI 3 project's root namespace is 'Accelerometer' (App/MainWindow live in `namespace Accelerometer;`), which shadows the identically-named WinRT type, so the compiler resolves `Accelerometer` to the namespace -> CS0118 'is a namespace but is used like a type'.
failed_apis.fix: Alias the WinRT type to a DISTINCT name: `using AccelerometerSensor = Windows.Devices.Sensors.Accelerometer;` and reference AccelerometerSensor everywhere. Aliasing back to the same name (`using Accelerometer = ...`) fails with CS0576.

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP sample sets brush colors with unqualified `Colors.Green` (via `using Windows.UI;`).
failed_apis.root_cause: In WinUI 3 the `Colors` and `ColorHelper` static classes moved to Microsoft.UI; only the `Color` struct remained at Windows.UI.Color. The agent tried `Colors`, then `Windows.UI.Colors` (both fail), before settling on `Windows.UI.Color.FromArgb(...)`.
failed_apis.fix: Use Microsoft.UI.Colors.Green (or `using Microsoft.UI;` + `Colors.Green`). The documented mapping exists but was missed; agent burned 2 build cycles and shipped a non-idiomatic FromArgb workaround.

special_apis.special_handling: WinUI 3 split: `Color` (struct) stays Windows.UI.Color; `Colors`/`ColorHelper` (static classes) move to Microsoft.UI. A blanket `using Windows.UI;`->`using Microsoft.UI;` rewrite is therefore UNSAFE.

errors_encountered.error: CS0118: 'Accelerometer' is a namespace but is used like a type
errors_encountered.root_cause: Project root namespace equals the WinRT type name it consumes.
errors_encountered.fix: Type alias with a distinct name (AccelerometerSensor) or fully-qualify Windows.Devices.Sensors.Accelerometer.

errors_encountered.error: CS0576: Namespace '<global namespace>' contains a definition conflicting with alias 'Accelerometer'
errors_encountered.root_cause: Agent's first fix aliased the type to the SAME name as the colliding namespace (`using Accelerometer = ...`).
errors_encountered.fix: Choose an alias name that does not collide with the project namespace (AccelerometerSensor).

errors_encountered.error: CS0103/CS0234: 'Colors' does not exist / does not exist in namespace 'Windows.UI'
errors_encountered.root_cause: Colors static class moved to Microsoft.UI in WinUI 3.

errors_encountered.error: Xaml Internal Error WMC9999: Object reference not set... + WMC1509 No LocalAssembly during MarkupCompilePass2
errors_encountered.root_cause: Cascading symptom: the XAML markup compiler pass 2 cannot resolve project types because the C# code-behind failed to compile. Not a real XAML problem.
errors_encountered.fix: Ignore WMC9999/WMC1509 and fix the underlying CS#### code-behind errors first; the XAML errors disappear once the project compiles.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: CS0118 across 6+ files, then CS0576 after the first fix attempt
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Root-namespace == WinRT type name collision; first remedy used a same-name alias which re-collided.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Renamed the alias to AccelerometerSensor (distinct) across all files.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A prominent 'Common build errors' entry in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md covering CS0118/CS0576 for project-name vs WinRT-type collisions, prescribing a distinct-name alias and explicitly warning against same-name aliasing.

dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Colors moved to Microsoft.UI; mapping was buried in a 13-row namespace table and not applied.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Replaced with Windows.UI.Color.FromArgb workaround (functional but non-idiomatic).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Sharpen the Colors row into a dedicated 'common build error' note covering the unqualified `Colors.X` form and the Color-struct-stays / Colors-class-moves split; and auto-rewrite the qualified token in Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1.

env_issues.issue: No accelerometer hardware on the build machine ('Standard accelerometer not found').
env_issues.workaround: Both UWP golden and WinUI app show the not-found status; scoring treated it as a symmetric hardware gate, not a regression. Agent added a defensive no-sensor fallback message.
